output.summary: The problem (PD-1): customer refunds fail in payment-db due to an IBAN format validation defect (5/5 recorded refund_failures show FAILED_IBAN_FORMAT, E-01); the resulting ticket backlog is driven by customers chasing these stuck refunds, not slow support, since agents reply within SLA (median 2.0h vs 24h across 900 tickets, E-02). The DEFINE Gate returned CONDITIONAL_PASS, deferring two critical unknowns to verification obligations (VOBs) that remain OPEN. The release decision is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION (no holds): only diagnosis of the IBAN defect and ongoing monitoring were shipped (SD-1 release_scope), while fixing the validation logic and correlating tickets to refunds were withheld because their VOBs are still OPEN and payment-db is read-only.

limitations_explained: DEFINE Gate only reached CONDITIONAL_PASS; the deferred critical unknowns are tracked as open verification obligations, not resolved facts.

VOB-U-IBAN-DEFECT-SCOPE is OPEN: whether the IBAN defect is systemic or limited to a subset of refunds/banks is unverified, blocking fix_iban_validation_logic:DA-PAY, which was excluded from release scope.

VOB-U-TICKET-REFUND-CORRELATION-FR is OPEN: what fraction of the 900 tickets actually trace to stuck refunds is unverified, so correlate_tickets_with_refund_failures:DA-TCK was withheld and SC-TICKET-VOLUME-DROP cannot be confirmed this round.
The bank-api tool is DEGRADED (ACCESS_DENIED on settlement_status); unknown U-BANK-API-RELATION asks whether this is related to the IBAN failures, and it has not yet been escalated to a formal VOB.
The IBAN validation logic itself was not corrected: payment-db access is read-only this round, so SR-FIX-IBAN-VALIDATION-LOGIC could not be executed even though it would remove the root cause.
A residual gap remains for tickets lacking a clean refund-ID reference, per the SR-CORRELATE-TICKETS-TO-REFUNDS description, affecting any future correlation attempt.
Supporting metrics M-REFUND-RELATED-TICKET-COUNT and M-REFUND-RESOLUTION-TIME have no current_value, so ticket-volume and resolution-time impacts of the defect are not yet quantified.
